question: Which function key in Excel helps to switch to edit mode?
solution:
​The correct answer is __**F2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The function key in Excel helps to switch to edit mode, that is **F2**.
 
• The function key **F2** allows to quickly and easily edit the data of a cell by activating** Excel's edit mode** and placing the insertion point at the end of the active cell's existing contents.
 
• Pressing the **F2 key** puts the cell in Excel's edit mode. If the cell contains a formula, We will see the formula in the cell and be able to edit it.
 
• Use the** mouse to click the formula bar** at the top of the window. The cell activates, and it switches to **editing mode**. We also double-click** the cell** to activate **editing mode**, or we can press the **"F2"** key.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Function key**
 **Description**
 
 

 F5
 The **"F5" key** displays the **"Go-To" dialogue box**. The "Go-To" box will list down the valid "named range" available in the opened Excel workbook.
 
 

 F3
 The **"F3" key** helps in Excel to **paste the name or paste the list into the selected cell as displayed in the below image**. This function key will not work until and unless the list that you have created is having a "named range".
 
 

 F7
 The **"F7" key** opens the **"Spelling"** option in excel using which you can check the spellings in your workbook. It provides the same output as you get by navigating to the **"Review"** Tab on the top of the excel ribbon and then clicking on the **"Spelling"** button.
